name: agent_ask
description: Ask one of your delegated children a question. Returns an ask_id at once; it does not wait for the answer. The question becomes the child's next turn (an idle child is woken for it; a busy one sees it at its next boundary). The answer is whatever the child itself sends back quoting the ask_id in in_reply_to: it reaches you as mail, and its arrival triggers your next turn. The child's automatic turn report may quote the ask_id too; it is marked automatic and is not the answer. If the child ends without answering, an exited notice quoting the ask_id tells you so. Only your OWN children may be asked.

harp.description: The child session harp to ask (from agent_run's harp, or the roster)

text.description: The question, delivered verbatim as the child's next turn under a header naming it a question from you that expects an answer.

outputSchema.description: Answers a question or summarize ask at once, before the child has read it.

ask_id.description: The ask's id. The child's answer quotes it in in_reply_to, and so does the exited notice if the child ends without answering.
